parts.text:
To what extent did your understanding of the conventions of real media texts determine your
decision-making?

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Analyse one of your productions in relation to ideas about audience. 
Section B: Contemporary media issues
Answer one question from Section B.
You should refer to at least two different media and support your answer with reference to contemporary
examples.
Contemporary media regulation

text: ‘Media regulation is becoming less restrictive.’ How far do you agree with this statement? [50]
OR
To what extent can the media be effectively regulated? [50]
Global media
To what extent have global media transformed local culture? [50]
OR
Evaluate the arguments for and against global media in relation to production. [50]
Media and collective identity
Analyse the representation of a particular social group in the media. [50]
OR
‘Collective identity is always stereotyped in the media.’ How far do you agree with this statement?
Media in the online age
‘In the online age, anyone can be a media producer.’ To what extent do you agree with this
statement? [50]
OR
Evaluate the impact of online media on distribution. [50]
Postmodern media
Explain the ways in which studying postmodernism has changed your understanding of the media.
OR
Evaluate the arguments for and against understanding particular media forms as postmodern.
